title: Gawad APJL honors ten longest-staying Filipinos in Spain and Andorra

blocks.text: The Philippine Embassy in Madrid, led by Philippine Ambassador for Spain and Andorra H.E. Philippe J. Lhuillier, honored ten of the longest-staying Filipinos in the region, whose decades of hard work and sacrifice have helped foster greater appreciation for Filipinos in their adopted communities. Established in 2018 by Ambassador Philippe J. Lhuillier, the Gawad Ambassador Philippe J. Lhuillier Para sa Sampung (10) Pinakamatagal na Pilipino sa Spain at Andorra (Gawad APJL) honors Filipino pioneers who built their lives abroad when settling there was far more challenging than it is today.
